title: Kagamine Len — Cheers ☆ For ☆ You!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Tsukasa and the others are probably doing their best at the Morinomiya Music Academy right now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They said it's a really amazing school, so I hope they get to experience lots of different things.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... I also wanna do something that can help me become a better actor, but I don't know what...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait a second... Nene said that she's gonna be auditioning for a role!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You can learn a lot by watching a bunch of different people play the same character, so I might give that a try.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hi, Len!
How are you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Emu! Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You were at Morinomiya today, right?
Are you all done for the day?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup♪ I've been learning a ton about how they run things!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But I'm taking a quick break!
I don't get to work on my acting while I'm with them, so I'm gonna practice on my own now♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really?! Then, let's practice together.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh...
I know...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Say, Emu!
Let's try auditioning... No, actually...
Wanna have an acting contest with me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: An acting contest?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I want to do more stuff that can help me become a better actor!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And just now, I thought that a contest would allow me to see a bunch of different people play the same character!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, that sounds like fun☆
You're a genius, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. The truth is, you playing Ushiwakamaru is what gave me the idea!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: By holding a contest like this, I feel like I can learn a lot about how to act cool or cute or elegant! What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It sounds like a lot of fun!
So, Len, you can count me in!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks! Then, let's go over and ask KAITO to see if we can use the stage!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. An acting contest.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think it's a wonderful idea, so let's run with it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Woohoo! Thanks, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, let's start by deciding the overall framework for it. That includes coming up with the rules, categories and such.

rows.Speaker: Len & Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Extra! Extra!
This just in, Len and Emu are holding an acting contest in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: All those who wish to learn more about acting are welcome to join! Take a flyer to find out more details♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow! An acting contest?!
Can I have a flyer?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Extra! Extra!
Len and Emu are holding an acting contest in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everybody with confidence in acting cool, cute or elegant is welcome to join!
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: Hi, Emu! You're passing out flyers?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Something fun must be happening!
Would you mind giving me one as well?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Welcome back, you two!
Did everyone take a flyer?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! A lot of them even said that they wanted to join, so we've got tons and tons more participants now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: MEIKO and the plushies all said that they wanted to join in on the fun♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I think we're in for a very lively contest.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. Now we need to pick a good script for it, right?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right. Would you two be okay with helping out a little while longer?

rows.Speaker: Len & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wonderful!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: While you two were passing out flyers, I tried searching for some suitable manuscripts...
